title: Fewer Returns on Shopify: A Size Guide Shoppers Trust #Shorts
description:
Every wrong size is a return, a refund and a second shipping cost.

UTD themes Boutique and Gain put a full size guide right on the product page: international, European and local sizes with body measurements, plus the model's height, measurements and the exact size she's wearing. Shoppers compare with their own and pick a size easily.

Fewer returns, less spent on shipping and refunds, and customers who trust your store.

▶ Boutique and Gain in the official Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd
